subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiomatic expression to substitute for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I had __to work late in the night__ for nearly three months to write my first book.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 i.e. 'to burn the midnight oil'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"to work late in the night"** suggests putting in extra hours of work, often late into the night.
